manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
description:
If Conjurer's Bauble is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Conjurer's Bauble. Then, cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Temporal Manipulation onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Temporal Manipulation from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.
